title: How do I get CE credit for sessions at the annual meeting?

nodes.label: Badge scan
nodes.detail: Ushers scan your conference badge when you enter and exit the room.

nodes.label: Meeting app
nodes.detail: Alternatively, enter the 4-digit session code announced at the end of the talk.

nodes.label: Attendance log
nodes.detail: Raw badge scans and app check-ins are matched to your member record.

nodes.label: Time check
nodes.detail: Sessions require at least 45 minutes of verified attendance to earn CE credit.

nodes.label: CE transcript
nodes.detail: Approved credits post to your official member CE transcript within 2 weeks.

nodes.label: Member portal
nodes.detail: Download attendance certificates or apply credits directly toward renewal.

nodes.label: Cert board
nodes.detail: The association sends a monthly export of earned credits to the certification board.

cards.title: Earning session credit
cards.body: Scan your badge at the door or enter the session code in the app, and stay at least 45 minutes.

cards.title: Where credits appear
cards.body: Credits show in the member portal within 2 weeks and export to the certification board monthly.
